topic.title: Frequently Asked Questions
topic.shortdesc: Answers to the most commonly asked questions about .

dlentry.dd: supports Windows 10 and later, macOS 12 and later, and major Linux distributions (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian).

dlentry.dt: Is there a free trial available?
dlentry.dd: Yes. You can download a fully functional trial from our website. The trial period lasts 30 days.

dlentry.dt: How do I activate my license?
dlentry.dd:
After purchasing, you will receive a license key by email. Enter it in
Help Register to activate your copy.

dlentry.dt: Can I transfer my license to another computer?
dlentry.dd: Yes. Deactivate the license on the current machine first, then activate it on the new one.
